text: Power engineering and thermophysics is a core discipline that studies energy conversion and utilization, as well as thermal science and engineering, and it belongs to the first-level discipline of engineering. It is supported by fundamental theories such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer, and combines cross-disciplinary fields like mechanical engineering and control science. It is dedicated to addressing key issues such as efficient energy utilization, power system optimization, and thermal management. It serves as an important theoretical and technical foundation for industries such as energy, aerospace, power, and environmental protection, and possesses extremely strong engineering practicality and interdisciplinary attributes.
